user.title: Connect to Teletask Central Unit
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Teletask central unit.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of your Teletask central unit.
data_description.port: TCP port of the central unit — default is {default_port}.
data_description.central_id: A unique name to identify this central unit, e.g. my_teletask.

config.title: Teletask Component Configuration
config.description:
Enter the path to your config.json file on the Home Assistant server.

Example: `{example_path}`

Relative paths are resolved from your Home Assistant configuration folder, and the file must be inside it. The path is remembered: after editing the file, just reload the integration.

data_description.config_file_path: Full or relative path to your Teletask config.json file, e.g. teletask/config.json

error.cannot_resolve: Hostname could not be resolved. Check that the hostname is correct and your DNS is working.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Teletask central unit. Check the hostname or IP address and port.
error.invalid_json: The file is not valid JSON — {error}
error.path_outside_config: For security reasons, the file must be inside the Home Assistant configuration folder ({error}).
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Teletask central unit is already configured.

reload_file.title: Reload from File
reload_file.description:
Read the component configuration from this file and reload the integration. Change the path to link a different file.

Example: `{example_path}`

data_description.config_file_path: Relative paths are resolved from your Home Assistant configuration folder.

data_description.debug_log: Logs every sent and received byte to the Home Assistant log at DEBUG level. Disable when not actively debugging.

edit_components.title: Edit Components
edit_components.description:
Choose a component type to add, change or remove its components. You can edit several types before saving.

{status}

edit_type.title: {type}
edit_type.description:
Click a component to edit it, or use **Add** to create one.

- Entities keep their entity IDs as long as the number stays the same.
- **Area** only applies when a component's device is first created. To move an existing device, change its area in Home Assistant.
- A removed component's entity stays behind as unavailable; delete it under Settings → Entities if you don't need it.

Changes are saved when you choose **Save changes and reload** on the previous screen.

edit_yaml.title: Edit as YAML
edit_yaml.description: {note}Edit the full configuration. Saving checks it, writes it to {target} as JSON, and reloads the integration.

error.path_outside_config: The file must be inside the Home Assistant configuration folder ({error}).

abort.config_invalid:
The configuration can't be opened in the component editor because it has an error: {error}

Fix it with **Edit as YAML** or in the file, then try again.

central_unreachable.title: Teletask central unit unreachable
central_unreachable.description:
Home Assistant can't reach the Teletask central unit **{central_id}** at `{host}:{port}` since {since}.

Last error: {error}

Teletask lights, switches and scenes can't be controlled and their states aren't updated until it's back. The integration keeps retrying every 30 seconds, and this message disappears by itself once the connection is restored.

Check that the central unit is powered on and on the network, and that no other application is using all of its TCP connections.

send_display_message.name: Send display message
send_display_message.description: Show text on the Teletask touch panels of a display message.

message.name: Message
message.description: One text, spread over both lines. Not together with line 1 or line 2.

line1.name: Line 1
line1.description: The first line of the display.

line2.name: Line 2
line2.description: The second line of the display.

message_type.name: Type
message_type.description: Message or alarm. Left out: the display's default in config.json, or else alarm.

beeps.name: Beeps
beeps.description: How many times the panels beep (0-255). Left out: the display's default, or else 1.

ascii.name: ASCII
ascii.description: On: 16 ASCII characters per line. Off: 8 characters of any kind. Left out: the display's default, or else ASCII when the text allows it.
